full_text_en:
Procuratorial Authority of Wuhai City, Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region v. Bai Xueyun et al. — robbery

Ruling Summary

According to the provisions of Article 263 of the Criminal Law of the People's Republic of China, the crime of robbery refers to the act of forcibly seizing public or private property by means of violence, coercion, or other methods, for the purpose of illegal possession. The term "violence" as used herein refers to the act of the offender striking or coercing the victim's body, such as injuring, beating, binding, or confining.

Where an actor, for the purpose of illegal possession, lures the victim into a rented house by fraudulent means, then locks the victim inside a room that has been previously modified by the actor, thereby rendering the victim unable to resist, and then seizes the property carried by the victim, this constitutes the act of forcibly seizing public or private property by means of physical coercion through confinement of the victim's body. Such conduct shall be convicted and punished in accordance with the provisions of Article 263 of the Criminal Law of the PRC.

Prosecutorial Authority: People's Procuratorate of Wuhai City, Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region.

Defendant: Bai Xueyun, also known as Bai Xue, female, Han nationality, 45 years old, residing at Laoshishan Li, Shijingshan District, Beijing, unemployed.

Defendant: Wang Leping, male, Han nationality, 53 years old, residing at Ba Street, Qinghe Forestry Bureau, Tonghe County, Heilongjiang Province, formerly a worker at Qinghe Forestry Bureau, Tonghe County. In 1976, he was sentenced to seven years' imprisonment by the People's Court of Shangzhi County, Heilongjiang Province for the crime of robbery, and was released upon completion of his sentence in 1982.

Defendant: Wang Baojun, also known as Wang Zhannan, male, Han nationality, 45 years old, residing at Xiguan, Nanshi District, Baoding City, Hebei Province, unemployed. In 1994, he was sentenced to six years' imprisonment by the People's Court of Mancheng County, Baoding City, Hebei Province for the crime of robbery; released upon completion of sentence on February 28, 1999; on May 26, 2003, he was sentenced to one year and six months' imprisonment for the crime of picking quarrels and provoking trouble; released upon completion of sentence on November 25, 2004.

The above three defendants were criminally detained on March 5, 2005 by the Public Security Bureau of Dawukou District, Shizuishan City, Ningxia Hui Autonomous Region on suspicion of fraud. On March 17 of the same year, they were transferred to the jurisdiction of the Haibowan Sub-bureau of the Wuhai Public Security Bureau, Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region. They were arrested on April 11 of the same year.

The Procuratorial Authority of Wuhai City, Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region, filed a public prosecution with the Intermediate People's Court of Wuhai City, Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region, charging the defendants Bai Xueyun, Wang Leping, and Wang Baojun with the crime of robbery.

The indictment alleged: From June 4, 2004 to March 2, 2005, the defendant Bai Xueyun, together with the defendants Wang Leping and Wang Baojun, and the fugitive suspects Yu Haibao, Li Xiaoyuan, Xiao Ting, and others, in places such as Jining District, Ulanqab City, Inner Mongolia; Haibowan District, Wuhai City; Yinchuan City, Ningxia Hui Autonomous Region; and Dawukou District, Shizuishan City, lured victims to pre-rented houses on the pretext of purchasing computer accessories, locked the doors, committed robbery in five separate incidents, and seized various items including computer accessories, notebook computers, and Personal Handy-phone System (PHS) phones, with a total value of RMB 148,090 (the stolen goods have not been recovered). The acts of the above three defendants violate the provisions of Article 263(4) of the Criminal Law of the People's Republic of China (hereinafter referred to as the Criminal Law) and constitute the crime of robbery, and the amount of robbery is huge. Among them, defendant Wang Baojun recommitted a crime within five years after being released from prison, which constitutes a recidivist and should be given a heavier punishment. The procuratorate requests that the criminal liability of the three defendants be investigated for the crime of robbery.

The prosecutorial authority submitted the following evidence:

1.  Reporting materials and statement transcripts of the victim Zhang Junfeng. The main contents: At about 1:00 p.m. on June 4, 2004, Zhang Junfeng was lured by a man and a woman into a room on the pretext of purchasing computer accessories, and was then robbed of one notebook computer, four Asus 865 mainboards, four P4 2.8 CPUs, eight memory sticks, four hard drives, four graphics cards, and one mobile phone by the group.

2.  Reporting materials and statement transcripts of the victim Meng Fanliang. The main contents: On the afternoon of November 15, 2004, Meng Fanliang was lured by a woman claiming to be surnamed Wu and a man about 40 years old into a family building of the Wuhai Glass Factory on the pretext of purchasing computer accessories, and was then robbed of five P4 3.2 CPUs, five Gigabyte 865PE mainboards, ten 512M memory sticks, five 120G hard drives, five 9550 graphics cards, and one Toshiba notebook computer by the group.

3.  Reporting materials and statement transcripts of the victim Hao Zhijun. The main contents: On the afternoon of January 9, 2005, Hao Zhijun was lured by a woman over 40 into a room in the Bearing Factory Family Building of Wenxia District, Jining, Ulanqab City, on the pretext of purchasing computer accessories, and was locked in the room. He was then robbed of four sets of Asus 865PE mainboards, eight Kingston DDR400 memory sticks, four hard drives, four ELSA graphics cards, one IBM notebook computer, and one Samsung business mobile phone by the group.

4.  Reporting materials and statement transcripts of the victim Wan Xingzhong. The main contents: On February 28, 2005, Wan Xingzhong was lured by a man and a woman into a fourth-floor residence at No. 40 Family Courtyard opposite Shizuishan Normal College on the pretext of purchasing computer accessories, and was locked in the room. He was then robbed of four P4 3.0E mainboards, two Asus 865PE mainboards, two Gigabyte 865PE mainboards, four Colorful 9550 graphics cards, eight Kingston memory sticks, and four Seagate 120G hard drives by the group.

5.  Reporting materials and statement transcripts of the victim Yang Hongqiang. The main contents: On March 2, 2005, Yang Hongqiang was lured by a woman about 40 years old into a building in the alley east of the Economic College of Yinchuan Development Zone on the pretext of purchasing computer accessories, and was locked in the room. He was then robbed of two P4 3.0E CPUs, two Seagate 120G hard drives, four Kingston 512M memory sticks, two 865PE mainboards, two Abit 865PE mainboards, two Leadtek graphics cards, and one Starcom PHS phone by the group.

6.  Identification transcripts. The main contents: After the incidents, the public security authorities brought the defendants Bai Xueyun and Wang Baojun to identify the crime scenes. The two defendants identified the residential building at No. 24-3-8, Qingyu Lane, Qingshan South Road, Dawukou District, Shizuishan City, Ningxia Hui Autonomous Region, as a crime scene. After identification by the victim Hao Zhijun, among several persons to be identified, the person numbered 03 (i.e., Bai Xueyun) was the person who robbed him of his computer accessories on January 9, 2005 in Jining District, Ulanqab City.

7.  Price certificates for the items involved in the case issued by the Price Information Office of Haibowan District, Wuhai City, used to prove the prices of the robbed computer accessories, notebook computers, and mobile phones at the time of the incidents.

8.  Evidence such as lists of seized items, records of crime scene inspection, and photographs.

The defendant Bai Xueyun and her defense counsel argued: Bai Xueyun's conduct does not constitute the crime of robbery but should be convicted and sentenced for the crime of fraud. Moreover, Bai Xueyun is a first-time offender with a good attitude of remorse and should be given a lighter punishment. The amount of the second crime charged in the indictment is incorrectly determined and should be corrected.

The defendant Wang Leping and his defense counsel argued: This case should not be convicted as robbery but should be convicted and sentenced as fraud. Wang Leping was a passive participant and never came into contact with the victims during the entire criminal process. They also argued that the price appraisal department gave inconsistent price appraisals for the same items involved.

The defendant Wang Baojun argued: His conduct does not constitute the crime of robbery but should be convicted and sentenced as fraud.

The Intermediate People's Court of Wuhai City found the following facts at the first instance:

In early June 2004, the fugitive suspect Yu Haibao gathered the defendant Bai Xueyun, Wang Leping, and the fugitive suspect Li Xiaoyuan, and they jointly rented a Jinbei minivan to go to Ulanqab City, Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region. According to a pre-arranged division of labor by Yu Haibao, Wang Leping was responsible for renting a building in the city, then modifying the door lock of a room inside the building so that the door could not be opened from the inside after being locked from the outside, and sealing the windows of that room with wire mesh. Thereafter, Bai Xueyun, on the pretext of purchasing computer accessories, went to a computer company that Yu Haibao had previously targeted and placed an order for computer accessories with the company's employee, the victim Zhang Junfeng. On the afternoon of June 4, Zhang Junfeng, led by Bai Xueyun, delivered the computer accessories to the defendants' rented premises. Bai Xueyun asked Zhang Junfeng to place the box containing the computer accessories on the table in the outer room, and then lured Zhang Junfeng into the pre-modified room on the pretext of asking him to write a list of the computer accessories. Subsequently, Bai Xueyun left the room on the pretext of making a phone call and locked the door from the outside. Li Xiaoyuan took the opportunity to carry the computer accessories brought by Zhang Junfeng downstairs, and several people drove away with the stolen items. In this crime, they seized one IBM notebook computer, four Asus 865E mainboards, four P4 2.8 CPUs, eight memory sticks, four 120G hard drives, four Colorful graphics cards, and one UT318 PHS phone, with a total value of RMB 36,900. None of the stolen items have been recovered.

On November 15, 2004, the fugitive suspect Yu Haibao gathered the defendant Bai Xueyun, Wang Leping, and the fugitive suspect Li Xiaoyuan to go to Haibowan District, Wuhai City, Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region. Using the same method as above, they seized from Xianfeng Computer Technology Company five P4 3.0E CPUs, five 865PE Gigabyte mainboards, ten Kingston 512M memory sticks, five Seagate 120G hard drives, five Colorful 9600 graphics cards, and one Toshiba A601 notebook computer, with a total value of RMB 38,600. None of the stolen items have been recovered.

On January 9, 2005, the fugitive suspect Yu Haibao gathered the defendant Bai Xueyun, Wang Leping, and the fugitive suspects Li Xiaoyuan and Xiao Ting to go to Ulanqab City, Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region. Using the same method as above, they seized from Taiping Computer Company four P4 3.0E CPUs, four Asus 865E mainboards, eight Kingston DDR400 memory sticks, four ST 120G hard drives, four ELSA 960 graphics cards, one IBM notebook computer, and one Samsung 109 Century Red Wind mobile phone, with a total value of RMB 38,840. None of the stolen items have been recovered.

On February 28, 2005, the fugitive suspect Yu Haibao gathered the defendant Bai Xueyun, Wang Leping, and Wang Baojun to go to Shizuishan City, Ningxia Hui Autonomous Region. Using the same method as above, they seized from Dawanjia Computer Company, Guowei Electrical Appliance City, Dawukou District four P4 3.0E CPUs, two Asus 865E mainboards, two Gigabyte 865PE mainboards, four 120G/7200RPM 8M hard drives, eight Kingston 512M memory sticks, and four Colorful 9550 graphics cards, with a total value of RMB 19,200. None of the stolen items have been recovered.

On March 2, 2005, the fugitive suspect Yu Haibao gathered the defendant Bai Xueyun, Wang Leping, and Wang Baojun to go to Yinchuan City, Ningxia Hui Autonomous Region. Using the same method as above, they seized from Xinxiwang Computer Company, Xinchao Digital Plaza two P4 3.0E CPUs, two 120G hard drives, four Kingston DDR400 memory sticks, two 865 mainboards, two Leadtek graphics cards, and one Chinese PHS phone, with a total value of RMB 9,390. None of the stolen items have been recovered.

The above facts are fully confirmed by the various pieces of evidence submitted by the prosecutorial authority.

The Intermediate People's Court of Wuhai City held at the first instance:

The defendants Bai Xueyun, Wang Leping, and Wang Baojun, for the purpose of illegal possession, used deceptive means to lure the victims into rooms that they had previously carefully modified and arranged, then locked the doors from the outside, controlling the personal freedom of the victims, rendering them unable to resist, and thereby seized the property carried by the victims. Their conduct has constituted the crime of robbery, and the amount of robbery is huge. Among them, defendants Bai Xueyun and Wang Leping participated in five robberies, defendant Wang Baojun participated in two robberies, and Wang Baojun recommitted a crime within five years after being released from prison, constituting a recidivist; all should be given heavier punishments. The defense opinions of each defendant and their defense counsel that this case should be convicted and punished as fraud are not adopted. The argument of Bai Xueyun and her defense counsel that the amount of the second crime charged in the indictment was incorrectly determined is verified and should be corrected. Regarding the defense opinion of Wang Leping's defense counsel that the price appraisal department gave inconsistent price appraisals for the same items involved, upon investigation, since the victims in this case did not purchase goods in the same region or at the same time, it is normal for the prices to be inconsistent. Therefore, this defense opinion is not adopted.

Accordingly, the Intermediate People's Court of Wuhai City, pursuant to Article 263(4), Article 25, and Article 65 of the Criminal Law, rendered the following judgment:

The defendant Bai Xueyun was found guilty of robbery and sentenced to thirteen years' imprisonment, and fined RMB 20,000.

The defendant Wang Leping was found guilty of robbery and sentenced to twelve years' imprisonment, and fined RMB 10,000.

The defendant Wang Baojun was found guilty of robbery and sentenced to eleven years' imprisonment, and fined RMB 5,000.

Bai Xueyun, Wang Leping, and Wang Baojun all refused to accept the first-instance judgment and appealed to the High People's Court of Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region.

Bai Xueyun appealed, arguing: The appellant did not use violence against the victims and therefore did not constitute the crime of robbery; this case should be convicted and punished as fraud. Regarding the appraisal of the stolen goods' prices, the price appraisal department did not uniformly determine the prices for the same type of computer accessories, and the appraised prices were too high.

Wang Leping and his defense counsel appealed, arguing: The appellant did not use violence against the victims and therefore did not constitute the crime of robbery; this case should be convicted and punished as fraud. The appellant's status and role in the crime should be distinguished from those of Bai Xueyun; the appellant was an accessory and did not cause personal injury to the victims. The first-instance judgment's determination of the items involved was inaccurate.

Wang Baojun appealed, arguing: The appellant did not use violence against the victims and therefore did not constitute the crime of robbery; this case should be convicted and punished as fraud. The appellant only participated in two crimes, the value of the items involved was less than RMB 30,000, and he was merely an employee in the crimes. The first-instance sentence was too heavy.

Upon the second-instance trial, the High People's Court of Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region confirmed the facts found by the first-instance court.

The focus of the dispute at the second instance was: Whether the conduct of the appellants Bai Xueyun, Wang Leping, and Wang Baojun constituted the crime of robbery.

The High People's Court of Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region held: Based on the facts of this case, the conduct of the appellants Bai Xueyun, Wang Leping, and Wang Baojun all constituted the crime of robbery. The characterization by the first-instance court was accurate.

First, the act of the appellants Bai Xueyun, Wang Leping, and Wang Baojun of locking the victims inside the pre-modified rooms constituted a violent act of physically confining the victims by force.

According to Article 263 of the Criminal Law, the crime of robbery refers to the act of forcibly seizing public or private property by means of violence, coercion, or other methods, for the purpose of illegal possession. Instantly using violence, coercion, or other means against the owner, custodian, or guardian of public or private property and immediately forcibly seizing the property is the objective element of the crime of robbery and an important behavioral characteristic of robbery. The term "violence" refers to the act of the offender striking or coercing the victim's body, such as injuring, beating, binding, or confining; the term "coercion" refers to the offender threatening the victim with violence, forcing the victim to dare not resist; the term "other methods" refers to methods other than violence and coercion used by the offender to render the victim unable to resist or lose the ability to resist, such as anesthesia. All the above methods are criminal means used by the offender to commit robbery, rendering the victim unable to resist, daring not to resist, or losing the ability to resist. In this case, the appellants Bai Xueyun, Wang Leping, and Wang Baojun falsely told the victims that they intended to order computer accessories, lured the victims into their rented house, and then locked the victims inside a pre-modified room, rendering the victims unable to resist the robbery. This conduct constitutes a violent act of physically confining the victims by force.

Second, the means by which the appellants Bai Xueyun, Wang Leping, and Wang Baojun illegally possessed the victims' property was not deception but forcible seizure at the scene.

According to Article 266 of the Criminal Law, the crime of fraud refers to the act of illegally obtaining a relatively large amount of public or private property by fabricating facts or concealing the truth for the purpose of illegal possession. The term "fabricating facts" refers to inventing non-existent facts to gain the victim's trust; the term "concealing the truth" refers to covering up some existing fact from the victim; the term "deception" refers to the actor, through the above deceptive methods, causing the owner or manager of public or private property to be deluded and voluntarily hand over the property to the actor. In summary, deception is the means by which a fraud offender illegally possesses public or private property. In this case, the appellants Bai Xueyun, Wang Leping, and Wang Baojun falsely told the victims that they intended to order computer accessories and lured the victims into their rented house. This conduct is indeed deceptive, but the purpose of the deception was merely to lure the victims to the crime scene, creating conditions for the next step of committing robbery. The criminal intent subjectively held by each appellant was to forcibly seize the property carried by the victim, and in fact, the actual possession of the victim's property was achieved through the violent method of physically confining the victim.

In conclusion, the appellants Bai Xueyun, Wang Leping, and Wang Baojun, for the purpose of illegal possession, used violence against the victims on the spot and seized the computer accessories and other property carried by the victims, thus constituting the crime of robbery. The appellants had a clear division of labor and cooperated with each other in the robbery, constituting a joint crime. The first-instance judgment had clear findings of fact, sufficient and reliable evidence, accurate characterization, appropriate sentencing, and a legal trial procedure, and should be affirmed. The appeal grounds raised by Bai Xueyun, Wang Leping, Wang Baojun, and their defense counsel that the conduct does not constitute the crime of robbery are untenable and are not adopted.

Accordingly, the High People's Court of Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region, pursuant to Article 189(1) of the Criminal Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, and Articles 263(4), 25, and 65 of the Criminal Law, ruled as follows:

Appeal dismissed; the original judgment is affirmed.

This ruling is final.
